blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines- The Loboc Municipal Police Station in Bohol recovered a century-old brass bell less than 48 hours after its disappearance from the St. Peter Parish Church in Poblacion, Ondol, Loboc town. Authorities had received reports the bell was missing around 7:50 a.m. on Monday, Oct. 5, 2026. Police said that it had allegedly been stolen around noon the day before that. The Bohol police immediately launched a follow-up investigation and reviewed CCTV footage, which captured two individuals taking the brass bell before boarding a tricycle.
